themes.evidence: Contribute to strategic design and evolution of the people data platform and tooling (SQLMesh, Iceberg, Flyte)
own the full data lifecycle from ingestion to analytics-ready datasets for People Analysts and business stakeholders
champion data-engineering best practices (version control, testing, CI/CD)
Partner with People Analysts, HRBPs, stakeholders to translate analytical needs into robust data solutions
Design, build, optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest/integrate/transform diverse people data from HR systems
Collaborate with broader enterprise analytics/data-engineering teams on data architecture standards

archetype_rationale: Day-to-day is building/optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines, data models/schemas/ontologies, and a people-data platform with dbt/Airflow/Snowflake-class tooling — squarely analytics/data engineering, not agent or ML modeling.
notes: ML-pipeline is the closest vocab match for ETL/ELT data-pipeline work; the JD is data pipelines, not ML model pipelines. No agents/RAG/NL→SQL/LLM/RPA/experimentation/dashboards signal beyond preferred-BI mention.
